data.name: Munasir
data.gender_notes: Munasir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nasara' which means 'to help, support or assist'. The name Munasir is given to a boy who is believed to be a helper and supporter, someone who assists and strengthens others. The name Munasir carries the meaning “Supporter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munasir usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah make you a helper and supporter for the righteous cause.
data.etymology: Munasir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munasir total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مناسر
in_arabic.meaning: مناسر هو من يقدم المساعدة و الدعم
in_arabic.long_meaning: مناسر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ن-س-ر' والذي يعني تقديم المساعدة و الدعم. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يقدم العون و المساندة للآخرين، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و العطاء في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: مناصر
in_urdu.meaning: مناصر وہ شخص ہے جو مدد اور تعاون فراہم کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مناصر ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ن-س-ر' جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنا یا تعاون فراہم کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے۔ مناصر کا نام رکھنے والا شخص دوستوں اور ہم وطنوں کے لیے مددگار اور معاون کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुनासिर
in_hindi.meaning: मुनासिर वह व्यक्ति है जो मदद और सहयोग प्रदान करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुनासिर एक अरबी नाम है जो 'न-स-र' मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मदद करना या सहयोग प्रदान करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम विशेष महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह सहायता और समर्थन की भावना को दर्शाता है। मुनासिर नाम का व्यक्ति मित्रों और समुदाय के लिए मददगार और सहायक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مناسر
in_pashto.meaning: مناسر هغه څوک دی چی مرسته او ملاتړ برابروي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مناسر د (ن-س-ر) د ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی یو عربي نوم دی، چې د مرستې او ملاتړ معنی لري. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم د يو چا د ملاتړ او مرستې د وړتیا په معنا کارول کيږي. هغه څوک چې د مناسر نوم لري، د دوستانو او ټولنې لپاره د مرستې او ملاتړ په توګه لیدل کیږي.

in_english.meaning: Munasir means helper, supporter, or one who provides aid

In Islamic tradition, the name Munasir holds significant value as it represents the act of providing assistance and support to others. Etymologically, it is linked to Quranic principles of compassion and mutual aid. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote individuals known for their benevolence and supportive nature. The spiritual significance of Munasir lies in its embodiment of Islamic values such as kindness, generosity, and community solidarity.

historical_references.reference: Munasir ibn Sasan was a famous Sassanid Persian warrior who converted to Islam during the reign of Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab (634-644 AD). He was a prominent commander in the Islamic army and was martyred during the Battle of Qadisiyyah (636 AD), which marked the end of Sassanid rule in the Middle East.
historical_references.context: Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab's reign, Battle of Qadisiyyah

historical_references.reference: Munasir Al-Kalani was a well-known scholar of Hadith and Fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence) in the 9th century AD. He was born in Kufa, Iraq, and studied under many prominent scholars of the time, including Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal. Munasir Al-Kalani's works include 'Al-Masabih' and 'Al-Khasa'is', which are important sources for Hadith and Fiqh studies.
